title: Piplup — A Very Proud Little Wave
description: A freestanding, round-headed Piplup with a raised flipper, glossy oval eyes, white cheek mask, blue forehead marking, two white chest buttons, a pointed yellow bill, webbed feet and three curved tail feathers. Broad feet, interlocked skins and continuous internal spines support the sculpted character.

sections.name: One flipper waving, one flipper resting
Oversized rounded head and smooth crown
White oval cheeks and blue forehead
Pointed yellow beak and mouth seam
